justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/camera/open/CameraFacing.java, OpenCamera.java, and OpenCameraInterface.java. The package contains only 3 classes, and it is used by just two classes in the sibling com.google.zxing.client.android.camera package (CameraManager and CameraConfigurationManager via imports). Its outgoing dependencies are limited to Android framework APIs (android.hardware.Camera, android.util.Log) and same-package types, so there is no evidence that a stable package depends heavily on a less-stable internal package.
